messages:
maria: CI red on main: linux-amd64 blobstore-integration::UploadTest failing intermittently since ~main@{15h}. Anyone have a last green? Failing on upload timeout in test harness.

oncall-bot: Noted. Linking CI: https://ci.internal/red/12345. Retrying test...

ci-bot: rerun started: build/9876, test shard 4/8. Current failures: UploadTest x1/3 flakes.

shawn: I can take a bisect. Can someone paste the failing test log? Also any suspect merges around blobstore code in last day?

maria: log snippet:
```
E 2026-03-16 22:41:07 upload failed: POST /upload -> 504 gateway timeout
ERROR: client socket closed during chunked transfer
stack: test/harness/upload_test.go:128
```
Recent merges: `commit 3f1a2b4` (k8s sidecar change), `commit 7c9d11e` (kv: blobstore write buffer), `commit d4e8aa0` (ci: increase parallelism)

lee: my PR `7c9d11e` touched the flush path. Could that cause chunked transfer to close early? I'm watching.

shawn: starting `git bisect` locally between `origin/main~50` and `origin/main`. Will run integration shim locally; might take ~30m.

oncall-bot: Reminder: keep bisect jobs on short nodes; tag `@eng-infra` for heavy runs.

shawn: bisect found first bad commit `7c9d11e` by @lee — repros uploading large chunks when run with `-race` off. Repro log attached: https://artifacts/internal/ci/9876/bisect.log

lee: ack, that's the buffer change. I can open a revert PR if that's the cause. Any objections to reverting until we patch?

ada: +1 to revert, prod facing transient 504s today. Need hotfix.

maria: fine with revert. Can we do a canary on dedicated before wide revert? If revert fixes, we roll back the change and then reintroduce with extra tests.

shawn: plan: (1) @lee open revert PR referencing this thread; (2) @shawn run canary on dedicated (shard 2) once PR merged; (3) if green for 1h, roll out wider.

lee: opening PR now: https://git.internal/r/1234 (revert 7c9d11e). Adding `@eng-oncall` and `@eng-infra` reviewers.

ci-bot: PR build started: build/9880. Will auto-merge on green + approval.

maria: thanks. @shawn ping me when canary done. I'll update incident status and notify CS.

shawn: canary passed 12m ago (no UploadTest failures). Holding 48m for confidence then will trigger wide rollout. Will post final here.

oncall-bot: Note: thread archived when last_message_ts reached.

ada: thx everyone :tada:
